source_caption:
📺 Evil (2019–2024)

Evil follows Kristen Bouchard, a skeptical forensic psychologist who joins forces with David Acosta, a Catholic seminarian investigating supernatural phenomena, and Ben Shakir, a technology expert who relies on science and logic. Together, the unlikely team investigates mysterious cases involving alleged demonic possessions, unexplained miracles, disturbing crimes, and strange events that challenge the boundaries between science and religion. As their investigations become increasingly dangerous, Kristen begins questioning her beliefs while confronting terrifying experiences that threaten her family and personal life. Meanwhile, David struggles with his faith, and Ben searches for rational explanations behind seemingly impossible occurrences. Starring Katja Herbers, Mike Colter, and Aasif Mandvi, the series delivers chilling suspense, psychological horror, unexpected twists, and compelling mysteries while exploring faith, morality, human behavior, and the ongoing battle between good and evil.

🎭 Genre: Supernatural Horror • Psychological Thriller • Crime • Drama

⭐ IMDb: 7.8/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 42–55 minutes per episode • TV-MA

🎥 Creators: Robert King & Michelle King

📺 Seasons: 4 • 50 Episodes

📺 Where to Watch: Paramount+ in the United States.

source_details.synopsis: Evil is an American supernatural drama television series created by Robert and Michelle King that premiered on September 26, 2019, on CBS, before moving to Paramount+ for subsequent seasons. It features an ensemble cast led by Katja Herbers, Mike Colter, and Aasif Mandvi as three individuals from vastly different backgrounds who are tasked by the Catholic Church to investigate possible supernatural incidents. The series was produced by CBS Studios and King Size Productions and filmed in Astoria and Brooklyn in New York City.
